| description = 

There are technically two versions of this mob with different appearances: the Faydwer Crushbone centurions with blue skin and dark yellow garb (as seen in photo), and the Antonica Deathfist centurions with grey skin and golden garb. The Faydwer centurions drop [[Crushbone Belt|Crushbone Belts]], while the Deathfist centurions in Antonica drop [[Deathfist Slashed Belt|Deathfist Slashed Belts]]. These two varieties of orc also belong to different factions. This page is for ''Faydwer'' orc centurions.
